  PROBLEM: `untrusted_marker` is true when any untrusted marker-shaped comment exists, even when a trusted marker also exists, and the untrusted branch runs before the verifying and legacy branches.
  WHY: A forged comment can consume `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, record the callback as untrusted, skip the legitimate dispatch or completion path, and permanently drop the cycle; all reviewers agreed on the defect.

  PROBLEM: The tracking labels are applied before the marker comment is posted, so a failed comment POST leaves a labelled tracking issue without its marker.
  WHY: The poller can treat the partially bound issue as a legacy project and dispatch an unpinned `promote-main-to-stable.yml` promotion without the smoke/proving/verifying chain; all reviewers agreed on the defect.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 10722-10733 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `gate_started_at` is written to `STATE_FILE` without posting the updated state before the quiescence-unavailable branch returns.
  WHY: State is rebuilt from the posted comment on each tick, so the hold timer resets continuously and `COMPREHENSIVE_PROMOTION_HOLD_MAX_SECS` never triggers.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 10700-10706, 10709-10715, 10734-10737, 10774-10780 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Several terminal promotion-gate status writes are not followed by `post_state_comment` before returning.
  WHY: The terminal state is lost on the next tick, causing repeated comments and CRITICAL alerts whenever the final merge or gate condition continues to fail.
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:cycle job, lines 121-127 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN removed the cycle job concurrency lock without adding the requested atomic cycle claim.
  WHY: Two closely timed scheduled runs can both pass the best-effort `another_run_active` check and dispatch duplicate smoke/proving cycles.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:line 150 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq filter `select(.status == "completed" and .head_sha == $sha)` in `last_conclusion_on_tip` matches completed `test-and-mark-stable.yml` runs by head SHA only, with no `head_branch` constraint.
  WHY: After each promotion, stable and main point at the same commit. The promote cycle dispatches `gate_only=true` smoke gates on main. If one of those smoke gates fails, the auto-release script refuses to dispatch the real release gate on stable until the branch moves.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 10459-10460 (comprehensive_cycle_metadata_json) combined with elif ordering at lines 10863-10917 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq in `comprehensive_cycle_metadata_json` sets `$untrusted` to true whenever ANY untrusted marker comment exists, independent of whether a trusted marker also exists.
  WHY: When a trusted verifying marker exists alongside any untrusted marker comment, the untrusted branch fires, the callback is recorded as handled with `role: "untrusted"`, and the verifying-run bookkeeping never executes.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:"Create tracking issue" step, lines 1023-1038 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The binding sequence applies the label before posting the marker comment.
  WHY: A failed marker POST leaves a labelled but unmarked issue; the poller can later enter the legacy release path and dispatch an unpinned full promotion.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:lines 140 and 145 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `active_count` filter counts every active `test-and-mark-stable.yml` run on any branch and every active `promote-main-to-stable.yml` run regardless of event type.
  WHY: Main smoke gates and the scheduled cycle hold `release_in_flight` and suppress legitimate stable hotfix releases for hours.
(No task gaps reported.)

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:lines 139-148, the promote_runs_json / promote_active_count block added by the LAST RUN | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The promote-runs filter does not restrict by `.event`, so it counts the daily scheduled `cycle` job as an active promotion.
  WHY: The scheduled cycle can wait up to 5 hours for its smoke gate, causing stable hotfix releases to be skipped throughout that window.

  PROBLEM: The failed-gate latch matches any completed run whose `head_sha` equals the branch tip, regardless of `head_branch` or `gate_only`.
  WHY: A failed main smoke run on a shared SHA is treated as a failed stable release gate.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:comprehensive_cycle_metadata_json (jq) and the elif chain in handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed that handles the `untrusted_marker` branch | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any untrusted marker-shaped comment sets `untrusted_marker` and takes precedence over a valid trusted marker.
  WHY: The label is removed and the legitimate proving/verifying path never executes.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:"Create tracking issue" step, lines 1018-1041 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Under `set -euo pipefail`, labels are applied before the tracking comment.
  WHY: A transient comment failure leaves a marker-less pending issue that is later interpreted as a legacy release path.
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:`cycle` job, lines 121-127 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN removed the job-level concurrency block but did not add the requested atomic claim.
  WHY: Two scheduled triggers can both pass the best-effort guard and dispatch duplicate proving runs.
